description: Re-send an app's failed events after the destination is fixed, oldest first: by default those received in the last 24 hours, at most 50 per call (since and limit change both; limit goes up to 100). Events held by an open circuit are included. An event replayed once is not selected again, so a second call continues with the rest. The result lists what was replayed, what was skipped and why, and more: true while failed events are still waiting. Replays count against the plan's daily replay limit.

appSlug.description: The app whose failed events to replay.

limit.description: Most events to replay in this call, 1 to 100. Default 50.

since.description: Only events received after this ISO 8601 time. Default: 24 hours ago.

name: anyhook_replay_failed
title: Bulk-replay an app's failed events
